{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.12

|gr1= Turrets

|descr= Returns the class name of currently used magazine on specified turret. Use turret path [-1] for driver's turret. Note that a turret is not loaded until unit enters it, so this command will return "".

|s1= vehicle [[currentMagazineDetailTurret]] turretPath

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|p2= turretPath: [[Turret Path]]

|r1= [[String]]

|x1= <sqf>_magazineDetail = MBT_Kuma currentMagazineDetailTurret [0];</sqf>

|seealso= [[currentMagazineTurret]] [[currentWeaponTurret]] [[addWeaponTurret]] [[removeWeaponTurret]] [[turretLocal]]
}}
